seoTitle: Jeffco Public Schools Calendar 2026–27: Dates & PDF
seoDescription: Jeffco Public Schools starts Aug. 19, 2026. See the last day, major breaks, snow make-up dates, early dismissal details, official PDFs and a calendar download.
heroSummary: Jeffco Public Schools students begin the 2026–27 school year on Wednesday, August 19, 2026, and finish Thursday, May 27, 2027. Fall Break is October 12–13, Thanksgiving Break is November 23–27, Winter Break is December 21–January 5, and Spring Break is March 22–26. District-run PK–12 schools dismiss 2.5 hours early on the last day; charter schools set their own dismissal schedules.
heroFactChips: May 27: district-run PK–12 dismisses 2.5 hours early

calendarNotes: Jeffco lists 79 first-semester and 92 second-semester student contact days, for 171 total, alongside 87 and 98 teacher workdays, for 185 total. February 12, March 29 and April 30 are teacher staff-development dates that may become snow make-up days. Winter Break ends January 5, so students return January 6. Spring Break ends March 26, but March 29 remains conditional: students attend that day only if Jeffco uses it for snow make-up. The PDF says additional modified contact days appear on individual school calendars. Its May 27 early-dismissal notice applies to district-run PK–12 schools and excludes charter schools.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Jeffco Public Schools start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for students on Jeffco's district family calendar is Wednesday, August 19, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Jeffco Winter Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs through Tuesday, January 5, 2027, so students return Wednesday, January 6. January 4–5 are also listed for teacher staff development.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Jeffco Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Jeffco Spring Break runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, March 26, 2027. March 29 is a conditional snow make-up date: students return that day only if Jeffco uses it for snow make-up; otherwise they return Tuesday, March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: Which dates may become Jeffco snow make-up days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Jeffco lists February 12, March 29 and April 30 as potential snow make-up days. They are otherwise teacher staff-development days, so families should wait for district confirmation before relying on them as days off.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Jeffco in 2027, and is it an early-dismissal day?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, May 27, 2027. District-run PK–12 schools dismiss 2.5 hours earlier than usual that day. Charter schools set their own dismissal schedules.

calendarFaqs.q: Does this page include every Jeffco modified contact day?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Jeffco says additional modified contact days are identified on individual school calendars, so families should check their school's calendar alongside the district family calendar.

customSections.content: This page follows Jeffco's districtwide Family Calendar for first and last days, breaks, legal holidays, teacher staff-development days and potential snow make-up dates. customSections.label: How Jeffco's 2026–27 Snow Make-Up Dates Work
